== Summary ==
The Players Committee's printable [[Virtual Set 0]] master PDF. The cover dates the official text to 1 August 2016. This copy was captured on 6 August 2016.<ref>[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], 6 August 2016.</ref>

Page 2 contains the icon reference. The printable card panels follow on pages 3–13. The original capped Starting Effects appear on pages 6 and 11.

* Page 6: [[Knowledge And Defense (V)]]
* Page 11: [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]
